method: Every entry resolved by DOI against the authoritative API (CrossRef for journal articles, PubMed esearch/esummary for the PMID, the Zenodo record API for the data deposit). No entry was written from memory. A fuzzy CrossRef bibliographic query was tried first and returned the WRONG paper for two of four entries, both times a same-topic SPIE proceedings item; those results were discarded and DOI lookup used instead. That is recorded here because it is the exact failure mode this audit exists to prevent.

references.cited_as: Isensee F, Jaeger PF, Kohl SAA, Petersen J, Maier-Hein KH. nnU-Net: a self-configuring method for deep learning-based biomedical image segmentation. Nat Methods. 2021;18:203-211.
references.note: CrossRef: title, Nature Methods, vol 18, p 203-211, issued 2020 / published-print 2021, first author Isensee Fabian. Independently corroborated by the citation banner nnU-Net itself prints at run time, which is visible in this study's own prediction logs.

references.note: Zenodo record API: resource type Dataset, publication date 2022-11-28, licence cc-by-4.0, creators list contains exactly one name. A draft of the write-up had cited three named co-authors from memory; the deposit does not support them and they were removed. The cited artifact is the data record, which is what this study downloaded and what carries the licence.
